emergency.gatePrompt: Smoke, a burning smell, fluid under the car, a crash, or visible damage to the underbody or orange cables? Do not troubleshoot. Get everyone out and away.
emergency.title: After a crash or if something looks wrong
steps: If it is safe, get everyone out and move well away from the car.
Do not touch orange high voltage cables, a damaged battery pack, or any leaking fluid.
Tell responders and roadside assistance that this is an electric vehicle.
Do not charge the car until a Tata technician has inspected it.

contacts.name: Tata RSA
contacts.detail: 24x7 roadside assistance, number in your owner's handbook

emergency.footnote: These are general EV precautions, not model-specific instructions from the Nexon EV manual.
